geometry.name: Wavefront OBJ 3.0 geometry statements -- v/vt/vn/f/g/o/s and this document's own state (vertices, texture coordinates, normals, faces, groups, objects, smoothing groups, unrecognized statements), plus the whole-document set-snapshot/no-mutation surface. The shared reader/writer for the whole file lives here; the material-reference subset reuses it (family-module pattern) rather than duplicating it.

material.name: Wavefront OBJ 3.0 material-library reference -- `mtllib`/`usemtl` statements, which name and select a companion .mtl material library rather than declaring this file's own geometry.
